data.research_question: Which current public organizations, public communication surfaces, and publicly identifiable organizational actors can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 458, 464, and 470 for the anarchist-violence area-code-hunt workflow?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic admission, literal and locality-derived public web searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, and public-role person cross-enumeration.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from proximity, attendance, employment, volunteering, public representation, or event participation.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
For overlay NPAs, locality association does not imply an organization publishes a number in the overlay unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: Neighborhood Anarchist Collective and Radical Alternative Development retained. NAC explicitly self-describes as growing the anarchist movement and publishes 2026 Eugene/Springfield activity. RAD is current with public email and Instagram @rad.eugene.oregon; BriJit Jenkins is explicitly identified publicly as co-founder.

It Takes a Village- Berwyn retained from its current organization-controlled Linktree and Berwyn/Cicero aid/resource surfaces. No sufficiently resolved named public officer was found. A separate Oak Park Mutual Aid name collision across current public sources remains unresolved and was not collapsed into one org.

Metro Atlanta Mutual Aid Fund added; Atlanta Food Not Bombs and Atlanta Solidarity Fund reused from their existing canonical records. Atlanta FNB remains anarchist-associated; no individual political affiliation is inferred.
